caption: The drawing depicts a single powder horn with a slightly curved, tapering shape, rendered in shades of light brown, tan, and dark brown, which mimic the natural coloration of horn material. The wider end of the horn has a circular, wooden cap fitted with two small brass pins and a central knob, which is colored a reddish-brown. The narrower tip features a carved, decorative wooden spout in a darker brown, with a small round finial and a metal ring holding a thin carrying strap that extends outward in a loose curve. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with a faint rectangular border sketched around it. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset sketch of a screw fitting, outlined in red, and in the bottom right corner, the artist’s signature and date “Samuel Freeman Del: 2594” is written in red-brown ink.
title: Powder Horn
